method.directional_rule: intervention iff sign==lib_vote; market iff sign==con_vote; otherwise neither
method.subfield_rule: top-count JEL themes; exact top ties receive equal fractional weight
method.accuracy: 100 * correct effective weight / side effective weight
method.b_dir_pct: 100 * (intervention-leaning error weight - market-leaning error weight) / all error weight
